ui_voice_status_000#4.text:
正在播放：
原来是这样……真遗憾

ui_voice_status_001#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_001#4.text:
正在播放：
没事没事，您的眼神很热情，很棒哦♪

ui_voice_status_002#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_002#4.text:
正在播放：
唔，这个嘛…………

ui_voice_status_003#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_003#4.text:
正在播放：
早上好～。昨天睡得好吗？

ui_voice_status_004#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_004#4.text:
正在播放：
呀！我一定要去！

ui_voice_status_005#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_005#4.text:
正在播放：
能这样独占，果然还是——

ui_voice_status_006#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_006#4.text:
正在播放：
今后也请让我一直追随 CHU² 大人哦

ui_voice_status_007#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_007#4.text:
正在播放：
那个时候真是非常抱歉……！

ui_voice_status_008#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_008#4.text:
正在播放：
然后让 CHU² 大人好好夸夸我，呵呵♪

ui_voice_status_009#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_009#4.text:
正在播放：
是的。那时候也和现在一样，非常开心

ui_voice_status_010#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_010#4.text:
正在播放：
是的。他们让PAREO拿过来和大家一起吃……

ui_voice_status_011#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_011#4.text:
正在播放：
好的！今后也请多多关注～♪

ui_voice_status_012#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_012#4.text:
正在播放：
是的！因为『可爱』很重要

ui_voice_status_013#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_013#4.text:
正在播放：
哈！那、那个对讲机……！？

ui_voice_status_014#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_014#4.text:
正在播放：
呵呵，您害羞了呢~CHU²大人♪

ui_voice_status_015#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_015#4.text:
正在播放：
小町同学，谢谢您

ui_voice_status_016#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_016#4.text:
正在播放：
当然，因为那样比较开心嘛

ui_voice_status_017#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_017#4.text:
正在播放：
当然！我怎么可能错过呢～！

ui_voice_status_018#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_018#4.text:
正在播放：
PAREO懂的~PAREO也看得陶醉了

ui_voice_status_019#4.name: run
ui_voice_status_019#4.text:
正在播放：
CHU²大人好像想自己一个人看，坐在那边了

ui_voice_status_020#4.name: run
